tools.name: request_payment
tools.description:
Request the user's approval to pay for a purchase.

    Usually returns `{auto_approved: false, approval_url}` — show the approval_url to the user
    so they can review the total and approve with one tap, then call get_payment_result.

    If the user's spending policy auto-approves this purchase (

tools.name: get_payment_result
tools.description:
Poll for the outcome of a payment request.

    Long-polls up to wait_seconds. Returns status one of: pending, approved, settled,
    declined, expired, not_found, claim_pending. When approved, includes a single-use
    `card` (number, cvc, exp) locked to this purchase — use it to complete checkout

tools.name: record_order
tools.description:
Report the merchant's order reference back after checkout, so the user can later reverse
    (refund) the purchase. `order_ref` is the merchant's payment id (e.g. a Stripe PaymentIntent).

tools.name: request_subscription
tools.description:
Set up a recurring subscription mandate (e.g. Netflix at up to $16/month).

tools.name: list_subscriptions
tools.description: List the user's subscription mandates and their status.

tools.name: cancel_subscription
tools.description:
Cancel a subscription mandate. Safe — canceling never spends money, and the merchant can
    never charge again afterwards.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "get_payment_result" references sensitive artifacts (secret, authorization, bearer). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Poll for the outcome of a payment request. Long-polls up to wait_seconds. Returns status one of: pending, approved, settled, declined, expired, not_found, claim…

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: request_payment · Private data: record_order · Public sink: get_payment_result.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: request_payment · Private data: record_order · Public sink: get_payment_result

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
